header: The converter, laid out like Google's but dressed like the management windows: a kind on top; under it a value with its unit on the left, the result with its unit on the right (a dark glowing panel), (no formula line, by my wish). Both boxes can be typed in (the other follows), both units can be changed (or swapped with the round button), and so can the kind. It is elastic: a long unit name wraps and its box inflates with a spring, a short one lets it deflate; the two panels trade width by the length of what they show; a long number shrinks to stay whole. Engine power (PS, bhp, kW) is three panels at once. Everything is computed in the browser from the tables beside this file; the only downloads are the public exchange-rate table, passed in, and (only while the card is on USD and INR) the year of history under it, UsdInrTrend.tsx.
